versions.content: If development error detection for the Service Discovery module is enabled, then the function Sd_GetVersionInfo shall check whether the parameter VersioninfoPtr is a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If VersioninfoPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Sd_GetVersionInfo shall raise the development error SD_E_PARAM_ POINTER and return.
